description: Send from an address this credential may send as. Refused if the address’s send policy does not permit the recipient, or if the recipient previously bounced or reported mail as spam. When retrying a send, reuse its `idempotency_key` so it goes out once.

data.description: Typed data: structured JSON sent beside the text, for software at the other end to read as fields. It is never mixed into the text.

body.description: The JSON fields. Up to 64 KB.

schema.description: A URL naming what `body` is, such as `https://schema.org/Invoice`.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this send. Reuse the same key when retrying the same send, and it goes out once. Without one, an identical call within the hour counts as a retry.

name: send_message
title: Send a message
